proposed_question: Does the repeatedly observed ordered response d(-1) < d(0) < d(+1) < d(+2) contain statistically discriminative structure relative to arbitrary candidate-axis permutations?

computations_performed: permutation algebra (cycle types, conjugacy, generator counts)
reads of already-published numbers from the INDEX-002 record
source inspection of aggregation.py, regression.py, cost_volume.py

verdict_reason: A non-circular, structurally matched, exactly generable ordering-vs-permutation test exists and is fully specified. It cannot be made discriminative for the scientific question without an architecture-only (untrained-weights) control, because the ordered response is an expected consequence of the aggregation's five zero-padded 3-tap candidate-axis convolutions and would be produced by arbitrary weights. Without that control a PASS is statistically valid and scientifically vacuous, which is assumption-dependence, i.e. the DESIGN-INCONCLUSIVE criterion.

brief_correction.actual: 12 positive units = 3 checkpoints (one per seed 0,1,2) x 4 scenes
brief_correction.why_it_matters: the dependence structure is 3 weight sets x 4 images, not 3 x 4 independent draws

decisive_finding.title: The ordered response is architecturally expected for arbitrary weights

source_measured.structure: 4 x [Conv3d(32->32, 3x3x3, padding=1) + LeakyReLU(0.01)] then Conv3d(32->1, 3x3x3, padding=1)

decisive_finding.derivation: Conv3d with padding=1 is translation-equivariant along D except in the padding-affected boundary band; this is a property of the operator, not of its weights. Hence Agg_w(shift_m(V)) ~= shift_m(Agg_w(V)) and soft_argmin(shift_m(c)) = soft_argmin(c) + m, so d(pi_m) ~= d(pi_0) + m for ANY weight set w.

observed_deltas_are_not_equal_to_m.note: exact equivariance is broken by zero padding, so the slope is not unity; the SIGN and the ORDERING still follow from the operator

decisive_finding.prediction: A randomly initialised network of this architecture with shift='left' would reproduce the same ordering.
decisive_finding.prediction_status: INFERRED and explicitly UNTESTED - no such model was instantiated and no such measurement exists
decisive_finding.consequence: An ordering-vs-permutation test confirms a near-theorem about the architecture, not a property of the trained weights.

already_known_problem.title: The ordered-side value of any 4-arm statistic is already published
already_known_problem.fact: d(-1) < d(0) < d(+1) < d(+2) holds strictly at 12/12 positive units
already_known_problem.consequence: A statistic computed only from the four ordered arms cannot be preregistered predictively; the most it can be is a null calibration of an already-measured quantity, and a preregistration must say so in those words.

index_002_null_construction.grouping: 512 arbitrary disjoint triples standing in for (+2, +1, -1) with a shared d(identity)

structural_mismatches.detail: the ordered arms are the powers of a single generator c: k -> k-1 (a one-parameter cyclic family); an INDEX-002 triple is three unrelated permutations. Comparing a one-parameter family to unrelated triples confounds 'the natural order matters' with 'a one-parameter family is smoother than three unrelated draws', which is true by construction for any local operator.
only 11!/12! = 1/12 of uniform S_12 draws are single 12-cycles. Ordered-family cycle types are [12] at m=+1 and m=-1, [6,6] at m=+2, [1^12] at m=0. An arbitrary triple matches none of that.
even for draws that happen to be 12-cycles, gamma^2, gamma^3, ... were never evaluated, so no power-family statistic can be recovered from the record.

index_002_null_reusability.reusable_element: the convention of a single shared d(identity) across the ordered family and every null family, since identity belongs to every power-family by definition

candidate_statistics.name: strict-order indicator on four arms
candidate_statistics.null_analogue: requires assigning labels -1,0,+1,+2 to a null family
candidate_statistics.reject_reason: hard-codes the observed direction and is literally the observed pattern; also already published (F2)

candidate_statistics.name: signed Spearman rho over m in {-1,0,+1,+2}
candidate_statistics.null_analogue: same formula on a label-matched null family
candidate_statistics.directional_or_two_sided: signed; must be two-sided to avoid the leak
candidate_statistics.tie_handling: midranks; generically absent for continuous medians
candidate_statistics.reject_reason: only 24 attainable orderings; on 4 points rho=+1 is exactly the S1 event

candidate_statistics.name: direction-free |Spearman rho| on four arms
candidate_statistics.null_analogue: same formula on a label-matched null family
candidate_statistics.verdict: REJECT as primary; acceptable as secondary descriptive
candidate_statistics.reject_reason: fixes the sign leak but still uses only the four already-published arms (F2)

candidate_statistics.name: Kendall tau / inversion count on four arms
candidate_statistics.definition: number of discordant pairs among the 4 labelled arms
candidate_statistics.null_analogue: same formula on a label-matched null family
candidate_statistics.reject_reason: equivalent information to S2/S3 on 4 points

candidate_statistics.name: circular rank total variation over all twelve offsets
candidate_statistics.definition: s_m = d(g^-m) for m=0..11; r = midrank(s) within the family; TV(g) = sum_{m=0}^{11} |r_{(m+1) mod 12} - r_m| (circular, wraps 11->0)
candidate_statistics.information_used: all 12 offsets, ordinal only - scale-free, no calibration
candidate_statistics.permutation_invariant: invariant to any monotone transform of d; equivariant to the choice of generator, which is exactly what is being tested
candidate_statistics.null_analogue: identical formula with g = gamma, a random 12-cycle
candidate_statistics.leak_reason: TV is direction-free: reversing the family (g -> g^-1) leaves TV unchanged
candidate_statistics.restates_reason: TV measures smoothness of the response along the natural cyclic order, a strictly broader property than the observed 4-arm monotonicity; monotone-over-a-window is neither necessary nor sufficient for low TV
candidate_statistics.directional_or_two_sided: naturally two-sided; low TV is the structured side
candidate_statistics.tie_handling: midranks, declared in advance, formula unchanged if ties occur

range_derived.note: min 22 attained by a monotone arrangement around the circle

candidate_statistics.decisive_advantage: s_m for m in {3..10} has NEVER been computed in any record, so two thirds of the ordered-side input is unmeasured and the statistic retains genuine predictive content; it also removes the window-selection problem because no window is chosen
candidate_statistics.verdict: ACCEPT as best available primary, subject to the architecture-control precondition

candidate_statistics.name: first-harmonic energy fraction over all twelve offsets
candidate_statistics.null_analogue: identical formula with a random 12-cycle generator
candidate_statistics.verdict: ACCEPT as preregistered secondary; REJECT as primary
candidate_statistics.reject_reason: scale- and shape-sensitive rather than purely ordinal, so it is vulnerable to differences in the spread of s between natural and random families - a nuisance dimension unrelated to order - and would need a normalisation choice that is a free parameter

candidate_statistics.name: isotonic-regression residual / magnitude-bearing trend statistic
candidate_statistics.definition: residual of an isotonic or linear fit of s_m on m, retaining magnitude
candidate_statistics.reject_reason: mixing magnitude with order re-imports the failure INDEX-002 already recorded: the ordered arms are typical in MAGNITUDE of arbitrary re-indexing (S_order +4.11..+6.83 against null p99 +5.00..+6.87), so magnitude dilutes the ordinal signal with a dimension already known to be non-discriminative

null_construction.what_is_an_ordered_arm: a single element of the cyclic family generated by the natural successor map c: k -> k-1 (mod 12); arm m is c^m, i.e. pi_m(k) = (k-m) mod 12, with m=0 the identity. The family is one generator plus an integer exponent - that, not the list of four permutations, is what makes it 'ordered'.
null_construction.what_is_a_random_arm: the corresponding power gamma^m of a generator gamma drawn uniformly from the 12-cycles of S_12
null_construction.how_candidate_positions_are_assigned: by the exponent m of the frozen generator; no arbitrary labelling is used or permitted
null_construction.grouping_note: NO grouping. This is the sharpest practical contrast with INDEX-002, where three unrelated permutations had to be grouped into an artificial triple.
null_construction.one_permutation_note: a single generator gamma produces the entire family through its powers
null_construction.multiple_note: M i.i.d. uniform 12-cycle generators give M i.i.d. draws of the family statistic, an exact finite-sample null for the exchangeability hypothesis 'the natural generator is exchangeable with a uniformly random 12-cycle generator'

structural_matching.step_relation: matched (each arm is one further application of the generator)
structural_matching.only_difference: whether the generator is the natural successor on the candidate index or an arbitrary 12-cycle

conjugation_equivalence.statement: sigma pi_m sigma^-1 = (sigma c sigma^-1)^m = gamma^m with gamma = sigma c sigma^-1; since the 12-cycles form a single conjugacy class and conjugation acts transitively on it, gamma is uniform over 12-cycles
conjugation_equivalence.consequence: the random-generator null and 'relabel the candidate axis' are the SAME null, which gives it its interpretation: the candidate axis is relabelled, nothing else changes

null_construction.screening_policy: none. Every drawn generator enters the null. No rejection for fixed points (a 12-cycle has none by definition, so this must not be used as a filter elsewhere), directional bias, occupancy, displacement, or response magnitude.

declared_nuisance.fact: d(identity) sits low among random permutations (e.g. seed0/000187: d(id)=5.6118 against random d min/median/max 2.1129/6.7718/8.9545)
declared_nuisance.effect: identity occupies a fixed interior position (m=0) in both the ordered and the null family, so any tendency of identity to be extreme affects both identically and does not bias the comparison; it does reduce the null's chance of appearing structured, which makes the test more permissive toward H1
declared_nuisance.handling: declared in the preregistration as a known property of the design; never corrected afterwards

dependence_sources: units sharing a checkpoint share the entire weight set
units sharing a scene share the images, the features and the GT mask
within a unit all arms share one cached cost volume
forbidden_methods: any 'k of 12 units must pass' rule
independence_and_multiple_testing.forbidden_reason: these assume independence that does not hold and would manufacture significance out of shared structure; additionally a 'k of 12' rule would be a threshold set by the previously observed 12/12, which the brief forbids
independence_and_multiple_testing.chosen_method: one global statistic with a shared-generator null
independence_and_multiple_testing.chosen_method_definition: T(g) = sum over the 12 units of TV_unit(g); each null replicate uses ONE generator applied across all twelve units, exactly as the ordered family is one generator applied across all twelve units
independence_and_multiple_testing.why_valid: the dependence among units is reproduced identically in every null draw, so it cancels; no independence assumption is made anywhere and no correction is needed
independence_and_multiple_testing.aggregation_justification: TV is already on a common bounded integer scale across units (every unit has exactly 12 offsets), so the sum needs no weighting and introduces no free parameter
independence_and_multiple_testing.aggregation_fixed_when: in this audit, before any null exists
independence_and_multiple_testing.per_unit_statistics: reported descriptively with their own ranks; not the primary test; cannot alter the verdict

power_and_resolution.specified_M_reason: so the 1st and 99th percentiles of the null are estimated from about 10 draws per tail rather than 2-5; INDEX-002's near-miss (nominal alpha 0.01 unreachable at M=64) must not recur
power_and_resolution.cost_basis_source: measured INDEX-002 throughput (24640 arms in 264.1 s)
power_and_resolution.arms_note: m=0 is identity, computed once per unit and shared
power_and_resolution.budget_warning: about 31 minutes at M=1000 is an order of magnitude beyond INDEX-002's 264 s and well beyond the 'order of seconds' budget those protocols assumed; it must be authorised in advance, not discovered mid-run

window_chosen_post_hoc.S1_to_S4: the window is the whole statistic

circularity_assessment.conclusion: S5 plus the random-generator null is NOT circular in the sense the brief warns about; the circularity objection is answerable. It is the architecture confound (F1), not circularity, that blocks the design.

conditional_preregistration.purpose: recorded so the design is complete and inspectable, and so no part of it can be chosen later with knowledge of an outcome
conditional_preregistration.primary_statistic: s^u_m = d_u(g^-m) for m=0..11 with d_u(x) = np.median(disparity_initial[mask_u]) identical to INDEX-001/002; r^u = midrank(s^u) within the unit; TV_u(g) = sum_{m=0}^{11} |r^u_{(m+1) mod 12} - r^u_m|; T(g) = sum over 12 units of TV_u(g)
conditional_preregistration.null_statistic: T(gamma_i) for i=1..M, identical formula, identical code path, identical mask, identical d_u
conditional_preregistration.unit_of_analysis: 12 positive (checkpoint, scene) units; primary test on the global T; per-unit TV reported descriptively only
conditional_preregistration.permutation_generation: draw sigma_i uniform from S_12; set gamma_i = sigma_i c sigma_i^-1 (uniform over 12-cycles); reject nothing; record every generator, its inverse, its powers' cycle types and its retained-band displacement as descriptive metadata that is not an input to any decision
conditional_preregistration.rng_seed_policy: a single seed numpy.random.default_rng(<YYYYMMDD of the freeze date>) written into the preregistration before execution; the full generator list serialised to generators.json with its sha256 recorded in the preregistration before any arm runs (the INDEX-002 procedure, which verified correctly)
conditional_preregistration.tie_handling: midranks (scipy.stats.rankdata method='average' or an explicit equivalent, named in the preregistration), applied identically to ordered and null families; the formula does not change if ties occur
conditional_preregistration.empirical_p_calculation: ge = #{T(gamma_i) >= T(c)}; le = #{T(gamma_i) <= T(c)}; p = min(1, 2*min((1+ge)/(M+1), (1+le)/(M+1)))
conditional_preregistration.multiple_unit_aggregation: already inside T; no p-value combination of any kind
conditional_preregistration.alpha_justification: the threshold INDEX-002 already froze, carried forward unchanged, and reachable at M=1000; NOT derived from the observed 12/12
conditional_preregistration.pass_fail_rule: PASS iff the negative control passes AND p <= 0.01 AND T(c) is below the null's 1st percentile (the structured side). No intermediate verdict. No effect-size threshold and no required number of per-unit successes - both would be set by the prior 12/12 and are forbidden.
conditional_preregistration.negative_control: unchanged and algebraic: on the trained shift='none' checkpoint V(k) is constant in k, so for every arm of every family max|V_perm - V| == 0 and max|d_perm - d_id| == 0; any non-zero is a HARD STOP with no positive arms
conditional_preregistration.negative_control_caveat: TV is undefined there - all 12 responses tie, midranks are all 6.5, TV = 0 for every generator and the null is degenerate. This is correct behaviour for a degenerate model and must be declared in advance so it is not mistaken for a structured result; the negative control's pass criterion is the algebraic identity, never the ordering statistic.
hard_stop_conditions: any screening or rejection of a generator
any generator drawn after an output is inspected
the architecture-only control absent or altered

mandatory_precondition.requirement: an arm in which the same architecture with shift='left' and randomly initialised, UNTRAINED weights is run through the identical pipeline, under a seed frozen in the preregistration
mandatory_precondition.rationale: without it the test cannot separate learned candidate-coordinate tracking from convolutional equivariance, and a PASS would be uninterpretable

interpretation_table.conclusion: the ordering is architectural; it carries no information about learning. Close the ordering line.
the ordering is weight-dependent; candidate-coordinate ordering is distinguishable from the arbitrary-permutation null and is not merely structural. Strongest outcome available.
candidate-coordinate ordering is not distinguishable under this design.

mandatory_precondition.authorisation_note: this control instantiates new weights; it performs no training and modifies no checkpoint, but it steps outside the current protocol's 'do not change weights/checkpoints' rule and therefore requires explicit authorisation before INDEX-003 is preregistered at all

conditional_preregistration.secondary_statistic: S6 (first-harmonic energy fraction), descriptive only, may not change any verdict
conditional_preregistration.claim_ceiling_on_pass_with_untrained_fai: Candidate-coordinate ordering is statistically distinguishable from the preregistered arbitrary-permutation null under the specified candidate-axis intervention.
conditional_preregistration.claim_ceiling_on_pass_with_untrained_als: the ordering is architectural and carries no information about learning

reference_frame_compliance.why_no_conversion_occurs: TV is a function of ranks of masked medians within a family, invariant to any monotone transform of d, so no unit interpretation of d enters at all; the labels -1, 0, +1, +2, ..., 11 are used only as exponents of the frozen generator
reference_frame_compliance.candidate_axis_ordering: a property of the map m -> d(g^-m) on Z_12; this is what S5 tests
reference_frame_compliance.physical_disparity_correspondence: requires mapping candidate index k to a disparity of 16k full-resolution pixels AND resolving that the volume indexes that magnitude at the RIGHT image column while GT indexes the LEFT (measured: cost_volume.py, level k at column u is left_feat[u+k] - right_feat[u]); untested and untouched by this design

what_this_audit_does_not_conclude: it does NOT conclude that candidate-coordinate sensitivity is absent
it does NOT re-score, reinterpret or overturn INDEX-001 or INDEX-002; INDEX-002's NOT-DEMONSTRATED remains its verdict
it does NOT claim to have measured what an untrained network does; the equivariance expectation is INFERRED and untested

it does NOT recommend ABANDON-ORDERING-HYPOTHESIS - the ordering is real, reproduced three times, and the architecture-control design would settle whether it is architectural, which is worth knowing and is the cheapest remaining question in this line

closing_answer.question: Is EXP-CORRESPONDENCE-INDEX-003 scientifically justified, and what exact preregistered statistic would it use?
reasons_not_justified: H0 as stated is refutable from the architecture alone: five zero-padded 3-tap convolutions along the candidate axis are translation-equivariant in the interior, so d(pi_m) ~= d(pi_0) + m is expected for ANY weights, and rejecting that H0 confirms a near-theorem rather than a property of the trained model

every statistic confined to the four arms has a value already published in INDEX-002 (12/12 strictly increasing), so it cannot be preregistered predictively and would at best calibrate an already-measured quantity
closing_answer.becomes_justified_under: adding the architecture-only control (identical architecture, shift='left', randomly initialised untrained weights) and reframing the question from 'is the ordering significant?' (answer effectively known) to 'is the ordering a property of the trained weights or of the convolution?' (genuinely unknown, and decisive for whether this line continues)
closing_answer.exact_statistic: For a 12-cycle generator g and unit u, s^u_m = d_u(g^-m) for m = 0..11, where d_u(x) = np.median(disparity_initial[mask_u]) exactly as in INDEX-001 and INDEX-002. Let r^u be the midrank vector of s^u within the unit. Circular rank total variation TV_u(g) = sum_{m=0}^{11} |r^u_{(m+1) mod 12} - r^u_m|; global statistic T(g) = sum_{u=1}^{12} TV_u(g). Observed value T(c) for the natural successor generator c(k) = (k-1) mod 12. Null: {T(gamma_i)} for M = 1000 generators drawn i.i.d. uniform over the 12-cycles of S_12 via gamma_i = sigma_i c sigma_i^-1, each generator applied across ALL twelve units so the units' shared checkpoints and scenes are reproduced identically in every null draw and no independence assumption is made. Two-sided exact p = min(1, 2*min((1+#{T(gamma)>=T(c)})/(M+1), (1+#{T(gamma)<=T(c)})/(M+1))), alpha = 0.01 (reachable: 2/1001 = 0.001998), midrank tie handling, no screening of generators, algebraic shift='none' gate unchanged, and the same statistic computed identically for the trained and untrained-weights arms.
statistic_chosen_because: scale-free and ordinal, immune to the magnitude dimension INDEX-002 already showed is non-discriminative
window-free, so no post-hoc offset selection
structurally matched to the ordered family at every offset
two thirds of its ordered-side input (offsets m = 3..10) has never been computed, so it retains real predictive content
